title: Front Desk Standards Card — Appointment Scheduling Check-In Methods, Grace Minutes and No-Show Timing
content:
Riverbend Regional Health's registration desks apply the following per-visit-type figures for check-in, late arrival and no-show timing on appointments booked under **Appointment Scheduling**.

## Figures by visit type

| Visit type | Check-in methods | Late-arrival grace (minutes after the start) | Marked no-show if not checked in by (minutes after the start) | Riverbend delay after which a patient leaving is not a no-show (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | front desk, kiosk, portal eCheck-in | 10 | 30 | 30 |
| Telehealth Video Visit | video waiting room | 10 | 20 | 15 |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | front desk, kiosk, portal eCheck-in | 15 | 30 | 30 |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | front desk, kiosk | 15 | 30 | 30 |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | front desk | 15 | 45 | 45 |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | front desk, kiosk | 15 | 30 | 30 |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | front desk | 0 | 30 | 60 |

**Patient arriving after the grace minutes** — for every visit type, the appointment is rescheduled, and the late arrival counts as a late cancellation.

## Column meanings

- **Late-arrival grace** — the minutes after the scheduled start within which a late patient is still seen.
- **Marked no-show** — the minutes after the scheduled start at which an appointment that has not been checked in is marked no-show.
- **Riverbend delay** — the minutes of delay caused by Riverbend after which a patient who leaves is not a no-show.

## Minute ladder — hypothetical start of 9:00

The start time is invented; the minutes are the card's figures.

| Visit type | Grace minutes run to | Marked no-show at, if not checked in | Riverbend delay figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | 9:10 | 9:30 | 30 minutes |
| Telehealth Video Visit | 9:10 | 9:20 | 15 minutes |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | 9:15 | 9:45 | 45 minutes |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | 9:00 (grace of 0 minutes) | 9:30 | 60 minutes |
